title: Provisioning: OTA worker answer and platform post-steps
caption: The OTA worker creates the tenant schema; the platform worker mirrors the ledger and runs six idempotent post-steps, each in its own transaction.

steps.label: create_schema, run_migrations, seed_defaults as velexis_provisioner (one transaction)
assign_amadeus_office → oldest available test office assigned, supplier_connections velexis/active
issue_api_keys → pk_test + sk_test (scope storefront), raw keys encrypted in provisioning_jobs.reveal_ciphertext
activate → tenants.status active, job succeeded, audit tenant.activated
notify → vx:invalidate tenant + connection; email.send tenant.welcome
on tenant.provision_failed or a lost lease: failure handler retries with backoff (30 s × 2^attempt) or fails the job and the tenant
steps.note: Failed provision: tenants.status failed, tenant.provisioning_failed e-mail, ops.alert.
